test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Tinu starts from point A and drives 55 km towards east. He then takes a right turn, drives 57 km, turns right and drives 61 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 66 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Tinu starts from point A and drives 55 km towards east. He then takes a right turn, drives 57 km, turns right and drives 61 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 66 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53671fe6d4651176cd585e8697870f1a0ab506f3452607c09ffba4ab2e133743.png] 

Thus, he should drive 9 km to the south in order to reach point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
